title: MOO: A Multi-view Oriented Observations Dataset for Viewpoint Analysis in Cattle Re-Identification
abstract: arXiv:2603.04314v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Animal re-identification (ReID) faces critical challenges due to viewpoint variations, particularly in Aerial-Ground (AG-ReID) settings where models must match individuals across drastic elevation changes. However, existing datasets lack the precise angular annotations required to systematically analyze these geometric variations. To address this, we introduce the Multi-view Oriented Observation (MOO) dataset, a large-scale synthetic AG-ReID dataset of $1,000$ cattle individuals captured from $128$ uniformly sampled viewpoints ($128,000$ annotated images). Using this controlled dataset, we quantify the influence of elevation and identify a critical elevation threshold, above which models generalize significantly better to unseen views. translated_title: MOO：用于牛只重识别中视角分析的多视角定向观测数据集
translated_abstract: 动物重识别面临由视角变化带来的关键挑战，特别是在空地重识别场景中，模型需要在剧烈的高度变化下匹配个体。然而，现有数据集缺乏系统分析这些几何变化所需的精确角度标注。为解决这一问题，我们引入了多视角定向观测（MOO）数据集，这是一个大规模合成空地重识别数据集，包含1,000头牛的个体，从128个均匀采样的视角拍摄，共128,000张标注图像。利用这一受控数据集，我们量化了俯仰高度的影响，并确定了一个关键的高度阈值，超过该阈值后模型对未见视角的泛化能力显著提升。最后，我们在零样本和有监督两种设置下验证了向真实世界应用的可迁移性，在四个真实世界的牛只数据集上展示了性能提升。
tldr: 提出了包含1,000头牛、128个均匀采样视角的大规模合成数据集MOO，系统量化了俯仰高度对动物重识别的影响并确定了关键高度阈值，同时在零样本和有监督设置下验证了其在真实牛只数据集上的可迁移性与性能增益。
en_tdlr: We introduce MOO, a large-scale synthetic cattle ReID dataset with 1,000 individuals captured from 128 uniformly sampled viewpoints, quantify the influence of elevation and identify a critical elevation threshold for generalization to unseen views, and validate its transferability with performance gains on four real-world cattle datasets in both zero-shot and supervised settings.
